pageDescription: Browse the {places}, with a map and a search near you.
noneYet: There are no {places} to show here yet.
mapPrivacy: The map is provided by OpenStreetMap. By showing it, your browser contacts that service, which sees your IP address. The list below works without a map.
mapFailed: The map could not be prepared. The list is still available.
tilesFailed: The map background does not load (connection down or blocked by the browser). The list contains the same places.
mapHelp: Drag to move the map, pinch or use the wheel to zoom. With the keyboard: arrow keys to move, + and − to zoom.
group: Group of {n}: click to zoom in
nearPrivacy: Your position is read by your browser, with your permission. It is used to compute distances on your device: it is neither sent to this site nor kept.
nearDenied: No problem: location is refused or unavailable. Pick a city below instead.
nearUnavailable: Your position could not be found. Pick a city below instead.
nearNone: Nothing within {radius} km of {from}. Try a larger radius.
coordsHelp: Type your latitude and longitude in decimal degrees, for example 12.3456 and 34.5678.
coordsInvalid: These coordinates are not valid. Example: latitude 12.3456 and longitude 34.5678.
loadFailed: Could not load this information. Try again in a moment.
noPoints: There is nothing to put on the map.
searchPlaceholder: A name, a street, a word…
externalDown: Some places (those that come from elsewhere on the site) could not be loaded right now.
fTypeHelp: Types are set in the “Types and import” tab.
fAddressHelp: Shown as written. Example: 12 Flower Street, Townsville.
fMapLinkHelp: Open the place in Google Maps, OpenStreetMap or Apple Maps, copy the page address and paste it here: latitude and longitude are read for you. A shortened link (maps.app.goo.gl…) does not work: open it first, then copy the full address.
fMapLinkHelpEdit: Leave empty to keep the current position. Paste another map link to change it.
fLatHelp: A number between −90 and 90, for example 12.3456. Not needed if you pasted a link.
fLngHelp: A number between −180 and 180, for example 34.5678.
fDescHelp: A few sentences in plain text (an empty line makes a new paragraph).
fPublishedHelp: Unticked: the place stays a draft, invisible to visitors.
emptyAdmin: No place yet. Add the first one with the form above.
addedDraft: “{name}” is added as a draft. Tick “Published” to show it to visitors.
needsPublishRight: It stays a draft: you do not have the right to publish.
errMissing: This item no longer exists. Reload the page.
errFull: There are already {max} places: that is the maximum. Delete some before adding more.
errHiddenFull: You have already hidden {max} places: that is the maximum. Show some again before hiding more.
errName: Write a name. Example: Downtown Studio.
errType: This type does not exist. Possible types: {types}.
errUrl: Write the full address, for example https://www.example.org.
errPos_empty: Say where the place is: paste a map link, or write the latitude and longitude.
errPos_missing: Say where the place is: paste a map link, or write the latitude and longitude.
errPos_short: This shortened link cannot be read. Open it in your browser, then copy the full address of the page.
errPos_none: I cannot find a position in this text. Paste a Google Maps, OpenStreetMap or Apple Maps link that contains the position, or two numbers like 12.3456, 34.5678.
errPos_range: These numbers are not a possible position: latitude goes from −90 to 90, longitude from −180 to 180.
errPos_number: Write a number with a dot or a comma. Example: 12.3456.
errPos_zero: The position 0, 0 is almost always a mistake. Check the link or the numbers.
extIntro: These places are published by other parts of your site (events, directory…). You see them here read-only: you can hide them, without changing anything on their side.
extNone: No place comes from other modules for now. If you install events or the directory, for example, their places will appear here.
hiddenExt: This place is hidden: it no longer appears on the map or in the list.
typesIntro: Types are used as filters and as symbols on the map. Example: Studio, Good address, Event. Pick a starting set, then change anything you like.
fTypeNameHelp: The name visitors see. Example: Studio.
fSymbolHelp: Placed on the map marker. Example: 🎙️. Without a symbol, a dot is used.
errTypeName: Write at least one name. Example: Studio.
errTypesFull: There are already {max} types: that is the maximum.
errTypeUsed: Cannot delete: {n} places use the type “{name}”. Change their type first.
tplHelp: Adds the types of the chosen set and removes the starting types you do not use. Your own types are never touched.
citiesIntro: A visitor who refuses geolocation can pick a city from this list. There is no automatic address search: add the useful cities here, with a map link or a latitude and longitude.
fCityLinkHelp: Paste a map link of the city (not needed if you fill in the latitude and longitude).
errCityName: Write the city name. Example: Springfield.
errCitiesFull: There are already {max} cities: that is the maximum.
importIntro: Import your places from a CSV file (exported from a spreadsheet). Recognised columns: name, type, latitude, longitude (or a map link), address, description, hours, website. {max} lines at most at a time: for a big file, start again from the line given in the report.
fFileHelp: Comma, semicolon or tab separated. The first line holds the column titles.
fPasteHelp: Only used when no file is chosen.
fFromHelp: 1 = the first line after the titles. At most {n} lines are handled each time; the report says where to continue.
fImportDraftHelp: Recommended: you review before publishing. Unticked, places are published right away (if you have the right).
importNothing: Choose a file or paste its content.
importTooBig: This file is too big (2 MB at most).
importEmpty: The file has no line to import. The first line must hold the column titles.
importNoName: The “name” column is missing. Add it to the first line.
importNoPosition: The position is missing: add the “latitude” and “longitude” columns, or a “map link” column.
importPastEnd: The file only has {n} data lines: choose a smaller start line.
reportDone: Last import: {added} places added (lines {from} to {to} of {total}).
reportFull: The maximum of {max} places is reached.
reportMore: {n} lines are left. Send the same file again: the start line {next} is already filled in.
